69521-surprise-house.title: Surprise House
69521-surprise-house.creator: Abbie Farwell Brown
69521-surprise-house.description: A book by Abbie Farwell Brown. On the main street of Crowfield stood a little old red house, with a gabled roof, a pillared porch, and a quaint garden. For many weeks it had been quite empty, the shutters closed and the doors locked; ever since the death of Miss Nan Corliss, the old lady who had lived there for years and years.

arxiv-1904-07728.title: On restricted colorings of ( d , s ) (d,s) -edge colorable graphs
arxiv-1904-07728.creator: Lan Anh Pham
arxiv-1904-07728.description: Abstract Abstract. A cycle is 2 -colored if its edges are properly colored by two distinct colors. A (d,s) -edge colorable graph G is a d -regular graph that admits a proper d -edge coloring in which every edge of G is in at least s-1 2 -colored 4 -cycles.

arxiv-1912-00948.title: Properties of nowhere dense graph classes related to independent set problem Thanks: This work is supported by the NCN grant 2016/21/D/ST6/01485
arxiv-1912-00948.creator: Grzegorz Fabiański
arxiv-1912-00948.description: Abstract . A set is called r r -independent, if every two vertices of it are in distance greater then r r . In the r r -independent set problem with parameter k k , we ask whether in a given graph G G there exists an r r -independent set of size k k .

arxiv-2104-09064.title: Automatic Stroke Classification of Tabla Accompaniment in Hindustani Vocal Concert Audio
arxiv-2104-09064.creator: To appear in the JOURNAL OF ACOUSTICAL SOCIETY OF INDIA, April 2021
arxiv-2104-09064.description: Abstract ABSTRACT The tabla is a unique percussion instrument due to the combined harmonic and percussive nature of its timbre, and the contrasting harmonic frequency ranges of its two drums. This allows a tabla player to uniquely emphasize parts of the rhythmic cycle ( theka ) in order to mark the salient positions.

arxiv-2212-09026.title: Magnetic, transport and topological properties of Co-based shandite thin films
arxiv-2212-09026.creator: Kazuki Nakazawa 1,2 , Yasuyuki Kato 1 and Yukitoshi Motome 1
arxiv-2212-09026.description: Abstract The kagome ferromagnet, Co-based shandite Co 3 Sn 2 S 2 , shows a large anomalous Hall effect (AHE) associated with the Weyl nodes. A thin film with a Co kagome monolayer was predicted to exhibit the quantum AHE, which awaits the experimental realisation.

arxiv-2305-05728.title: Designing of knowledge-based potentials via B-spline basis functions for native proteins detection Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates
arxiv-2305-05728.creator: Elmira Mirzabeigi, Saeed Mortezazadeh, Rezvan Salehi, Hossein Naderi-Manesh
arxiv-2305-05728.description: Abstract Knowledge-based potentials were developed to investigate the differentiation of native structures from their decoy sets. This work presents the construction of two different distance-dependent potential energy functions based on two fundamental assumptions using mathematical modeling. Here, a model was developed using basic mathematical methods, and the carbon-alpha form is the simplest form of protein representation.

arxiv-2307-16234.title: Fragments of a History of the Concept of Ideal. Poncelet’s and Chasles’s Reflections on Generality in Geometry and their Impact on Kummer’s Work with Ideal Divisors This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Differential Geometry Inspired by Mathematical Physics in honor of Jean-Pierre Bou
arxiv-2307-16234.creator: Karine CHEMLA
arxiv-2307-16234.description: Abstract In this essay, I argue for the following theses. First, Kummer’s concept of “ideal prime factors of a complex number” was inspired by Poncelet’s introduction of ideal elements in geometry as well as by the reconceptualization that Michel Chasles put forward for them in 1837.

arxiv-2312-17208.title: Microscopic Mechanism of Pair-, Charge- and Spin-Density-Wave Instabilities in Interacting 𝑫 D -Dimensional Fermi Liquids
arxiv-2312-17208.creator: Dmitry Miserev, 1∗ Herbert Schoeller, 2 Jelena Klinovaja, 1 and Daniel Loss
arxiv-2312-17208.description: Abstract We present an analytic theory unraveling the microscopic mechanism of instabilities within interacting D D -dimensional Fermi liquid. Our model consists of a D D -dimensional electron gas subject to an instantaneous electron-electron interaction of a finite range exceeding the average inter-particle distance.

arxiv-2506-11812.title: On the Performance of LLMs for Real Estate Appraisal
arxiv-2506-11812.creator: Margot Geerts (✉), Manon Reusens, Bart Baesens, Seppe vanden Broucke, Jochen De Weerdt
arxiv-2506-11812.description: Abstract The real estate market is vital to global economies but suffers from significant information asymmetry. This study examines how Large Language Models (LLMs) can democratize access to real estate insights by generating competitive and interpretable house price estimates through optimized In-Context Learning (ICL) strategies.

arxiv-2508-12903.title: A Stitch in Time Saves Nine: Proactive Self-Refinement for Language Models
arxiv-2508-12903.creator: Jinyi Han, Xinyi Wang, Haiquan Zhao, Tingyun li, Zishang Jiang, Sihang Jiang, Jiaqing Liang, Xin Lin, Weikang Zhou, Zeye Sun, Fei Yu, Yanghua Xiao
arxiv-2508-12903.description: Abstract Recent advances in self-refinement have demonstrated significant potential for improving the outputs of large language models (LLMs) through iterative refinement. However, most existing self-refinement methods rely on a reactive process with a fixed number of iterations, making it difficult to determine the optimal timing and content of refinement based on the evolving generation context.

pmc-11388268.title: Free radical fragmentation and oxidation in the polar part of lysophospholipids: Results of the study of blood serum of healthy donors and patients with acute surgical pathology
pmc-11388268.creator: Alexey Fedoruk, Oleg Shadyro, Irina Edimecheva, Dmitry Fedoruk, Valery Khrutskin, Leanid Kirkovsky, Viktor Sorokin, Halina Talkachova
pmc-11388268.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The interaction of reactive oxygen species with cell membrane lipids is usually considered in the context of lipid peroxidation in the nonpolar component of the membrane. In this work, for the first time, data were obtained indicating that damage to human cell membranes can occur in the polar part of lysophospholipids at the interface with the aqueous environment due to free radical fragmentation (FRF) processes.

pmc-11757017.title: Effects of the tobacco–maize relay intercropping pattern on soil nutrients and soil microbial diversity
pmc-11757017.creator: Kang Yang, Shuhui Zi, Chengren Ouyang
pmc-11757017.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The imbalanced soil nutrient status caused by the long-term monoculture of flue-cured tobacco are a concern. The tobacco–maize relay intercropping, widely used in Yunnan, may improve soil nutrients by enhancing the soil microbial community, but this remains unexplored. This study employed high-throughput sequencing technology to examine soil microbial diversity under tobacco monoculture and tobacco–maize relay intercropping, using the varieties Hongda and K326, respectively.

pmc-12451383.title: Distinctive fish collagen drives vascular regeneration by polarizing macrophages to M2 phenotype via TNF-α/NF-κB pathway
pmc-12451383.creator: Yuanchi Wang, Honghui Jiang, Yiping Wang, Yifan Wu, Xixi Wang, Ju Zhang, Yeqi Nian, Jing Liu, Zhihong Wang
pmc-12451383.description: Collagen is a structural protein that plays a critical role in tissue regeneration and is widely utilized in biomedical applications. Recent studies have demonstrated that collagen can modulate macrophage polarization; however, most studies have focused on mammalian collagen such as type I collagen derived from bovine and pig sources.

pmc-12505697.title: IRF6 C-terminal phosphorylation links inflammation and cell–cell adhesion in oral keratinocytes: implications for oral lichen planus
pmc-12505697.creator: Y Andrea Osorio-Osorno, Mónica T Parada-Sanchez, Liza L Cox, Timothy C Cox
pmc-12505697.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundOral Lichen Planus (OLP) is classified by the World Health Organization as an Oral Potentially Malignant Disorder (OPMD). OLP is characterized by chronic inflammation, which may contribute to its malignant transformation. In this study, we examined whether Interferon Regulator Factor 6 (IRF6), a key regulator of immune responses and epithelial homeostasis, modulates inflammation in oral keratinocytes via Toll-Like Receptor 2 (TLR2).

pmc-12569484.title: On the Influence of Apologies on the Likelihood of Lawsuits in Cases of Perceived Medical Negligence: Analysis of Archival and Experimental Data
pmc-12569484.creator: Nelly Arbel-Groissman, Eran Dorfman, Elad Yom-Tov, Paul D Feigin, Anat Rafaeli
pmc-12569484.description: BackgroundDisappointing medical care (DMC) encompasses cases of medical failures, malpractice, or errors. Literature suggests that individuals’ perceptions of harm resulting from medical procedures influence their intention to seek legal recourse and that apologies may mitigate the inclination for legal action.ObjectiveHere, we aim to scrutinize and potentially challenge this prevailing notion.

pmc-12597207.title: Compound heterozygous low-density lipoprotein receptor variants causing homozygous of familial hypercholesterolemia in two sisters: a case report
pmc-12597207.creator: Cai Li, Qiong Kuang, Yu Yang, Li Yang, Dongguang Zhang, Liling Xie
pmc-12597207.description: BackgroundFamilial hypercholesterolemia (FH) is a severe hereditary lipid metabolism disorder. Homozygous FH (HoFH) in particular was marked by rapid disease progression, with afflicted children at risk of developing coronary heart disease or even suffering from fatal myocardial infarction in their teenage years.

Kulp, Jesper Pallesen, Paul Leon, Mark Esser, Trevor
pmc-12705453.description: Local intramuscular administration of synthetic plasmid DNA (pDNA) encoding monoclonal antibodies (mAb) offers an alternative to recombinant protein-based mAb delivery.
